task.description:
Implement the Stage 7 Expression DSL вЂ” DSL-01 (Grammar conformance) on branch feature/WF02-dsl01-20260527.

Read the design artefact at src/design/expr.md before writing any code.

Implement the following files under src/expr/:
- error.zig   вЂ” ParseError struct and ExprError error set
- ast.zig     вЂ” Ast, Node tagged union, CmpOp/AddOp/MulOp enums, Value type, Context, deinit()
- lexer.zig   вЂ” Lexer struct, Token tagged union, single-pass scan producing []Token; keyword + builtin whitelist applied at lex time
- parser.zig  вЂ” recursive descent parser consuming []Token, producing Ast; ParseError includes line+column+token+message
- mod.zig     вЂ” public API: parse(), evaluate() stub (returns error.NotImplemented)

Also update build.zig to include the new src/expr module.

Acceptance criteria (mandatory before completing):
1. zig build exits 0
2. zig build test exits 0 вЂ” write unit tests in src/expr/parser.zig or a companion test file covering:
   - At least one positive case per grammar production (or_expr, and_expr, not_expr, cmp_expr, add_expr, mul_expr, unary, primary literals, dot-path, func_call)
   - At least one negative case per production: parser rejects invalid input with ParseError containing non-zero line and column
3. Error set validation: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' produces no output

Security checklist:
- No SQL (this module is pure in-memory; no DB interaction)
- No I/O of any kind inside src/expr/ (pure function contract вЂ” same rule as transition.zig)
- No catch unreachable on realistic paths

Branch: feature/WF02-dsl01-20260527 (already set up by Step 00)
acceptance_criteria: src/expr/error.zig, ast.zig, lexer.zig, parser.zig, mod.zig all exist
zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' produces no output
At least one positive and one negative parser test per grammar production
ParseError struct has line, column, token, message fields

result.summary: Implemented DSL-01 grammar conformance module (src/expr/): error.zig, ast.zig, lexer.zig, parser.zig, mod.zig. Updated build.zig to include the expr module and test step. Also fixed 13 pre-existing Zig 0.17-dev compilation blockers across src/definition/graph.zig, src/api/pipeline_context.zig, src/obs/metrics.zig, and 7 test files (** operator whitespace/type issues). All three acceptance gates pass: zig build exits 0, zig build test exits 0, no error-set warnings.
